landmark_policy: source-only SHA256(seed|atomic_id), one per drug then fill to 256; identical columns across methods
context_state_kernel: cosine of log1p line-level A-well normalized mean on source-selected genes; multiply perturbation kernel for interaction
identity_exposure_features: source-vocabulary drug one-hot plus source-vocabulary dose one-hot
scientific_scope: retrospective source-held-out protocol in one study; not a prospectively blinded trial
controls_permission: only methods ending __control_state may use target A-control molecular state; B-control truth never enters predictor
morgan_baseline_status: source linkage and 188/188 structure coverage audited; included before any prediction scores were observed
morgan_kernel: (Tanimoto full-source binary Morgan radius2 2048 chirality + numeric-dose equality)/2, with and without product A-state kernel
morgan_scope: additional molecular prior plus additive exposure information; not a same-information language encoder comparison or a drug-by-dose interaction model
six_encoder_formal_matrix_status: S3 planned core: six encoders in one study under unchanged S2 scientific contract; not complete cross-study benchmark
legacy_regression_scope: Rerun all original 17 methods; after freezing 29 predictions and before scoring verify original query/gene/landmark axes and float32 bits for every fold. Any mismatch fails; no tolerance changes.
scope_extension: Four preapproved frozen language encoders added without changing effects, feature panels, observations, landmarks, alpha, seed, baselines, or scoring. No test-driven model selection.
